policy: Reviewed values that are credential-shaped and are not credentials. An entry names the kind of pattern, the SHA-256 of the secret component the pattern captured (for a URL, its password; otherwise the whole match) and why the value is not a secret. Matching is by digest, never by path, so the same value at a new place stays allowed and a real credential in an allowed file is still reported. Adding an entry is a reviewed policy change and is visible in the diff.
